_comment: Per-finding suppression. Keyed by the stable finding id (check + file + subject),
so suppressing one instance can never hide a new one from the same check.
Every entry requires a reason — an unexplained suppression is indistinguishable
from a bug being swept under the rug.
Review these whenever the underlying files change substantially.

suppressed.4420065946: B5 — HIGH_LEVEL_DESIGN.md §0 (Revision History) is read by name, not cited as '§0': Stages 3–5 read the design docs' Revision History by name. Intentional.
suppressed.66742050f1: B5 — LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md §0 (Revision History) is read by name, not cited as '§0', exactly like the HLD's §0 above. Surfaced once intake 5d / Stage 0 began citing LLD §1 and §7, which put the LLD in B5's scope. Intentional.
suppressed.b3ef9b6ae5: E4 — stage-7 (the QA test plan) has no obligation key in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §4 template, so no constraint can bind it. Stage 7 was added with the Stage 0 template left unchanged, by the developer's choice (2026-11-12); recorded as a known trade-off in docs/DESIGN.md §10. Remove this entry once a QA-plan key is added to the template and to eval OBLIGATION_STAGES.
